text: Redmond Rovers build patiently from a free kick near the halfway line on their own right flank. They pass six times over almost 20 seconds, steadily moving the ball forward along the right side toward Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. Rory Mensah receives a medium pass 27 metres out from goal, near the centre-right area, then shoots with his foot, scoring to level the match at 1-1. The ball flies past the goalkeeper into the net after a well-worked team move led by Kian Coleman’s assist. [#682] [#689] [#690]
